history.summary: NOT ANCIENT: this is a modern temple built in the 2000s, not a heritage site. Conceived and built under the guidance of Sri Sakthi Amma (Narayani Amma) of the Sri Narayani Peedam trust at Thirumalaikodi, on a 100-acre campus. Construction took about 7 years; inaugurated 24 August 2007. The vimanam, ardha mandapam and sanctum are clad in about 1,500 kg of gold (bars converted to foils mounted on copper); the sanctum holds a 70 kg pure-gold Mahalakshmi idol. A 1.8 km star-shaped Sri Chakra pathway leads to the shrine, with display boards of Amma's teachings along it. Designed per Vedic/Vastu principles; messages from the Bhagavad Gita, Quran, Bible and Guru Granth Sahib are displayed in the complex.

name: Sripuram Golden Temple
town_description: Thirumalaikodi (Sripuram) is a locality near Vellore in Vellore district, Tamil Nadu, about 18 km from Vellore city; it is known almost entirely for the modern Golden Temple complex.

travel.road: Thirumalaikodi is ~18 km from Vellore city by road

visitor_information.opening_hours: General darshan 8:00 AM - 8:00 PM daily (some sources 8:00 AM - 7:30 PM); Abhishekam 4:00-8:00 AM; mobiles and footwear not allowed inside
